0x00.name: VM_OP_HALT_YIELD
0x00.semantics: Pops caller return frame (addq.l #4, a7; rts); terminates current frame execution loop.

0x01.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_ENEMY
0x01.semantics: Checks enemy count ($FF17B7); allocates entity slot via 0x00DA2A; sets type and initializes via 0x008D06.

0x02.name: VM_OP_LOAD_WORD_TABLE_17C6
0x02.semantics: Populates coordinate/parameter array at $FF17C6 until 0xFFFF terminator.

0x03.name: VM_OP_LOAD_WORD_PAIRS_17E6
0x03.semantics: Populates position pair array at $FF17E6 until 0xFFFF terminator.

0x04.name: VM_OP_CONDITIONAL_BRANCH
0x04.semantics: Evaluates condition (0=entity dead/count, 1=player coord, 2=item, 3=frame timer, 4=wave defeat); branches on match.

0x05.name: VM_OP_BRANCH_UNCONDITIONAL
0x05.semantics: Relative jump in bytecode script: adda.w 2(a0), a0.

0x06.name: VM_OP_LOOP_DECREMENT_BRANCH
0x06.semantics: Decrements counter at $FF1826[counter_idx]; if non-zero, branches by displacement.

0x07.name: VM_OP_SET_COUNTER
0x07.semantics: Initializes loop counter at $FF1826[counter_idx] to count.

0x08.name: VM_OP_WAIT_FRAMES
0x08.semantics: Sets wait frame countdown in $FF17B6, saves PC to $FF17B2, and yields execution.

0x09.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_PROJECTILE_SPECIAL
0x09.semantics: Allocates entity slot via 0x00D9BE; initializes projectile type 8 at world coordinates.

0x0A.name: VM_OP_PRELOAD_NEMESIS_DMA
0x0A.semantics: Queues Nemesis pattern decompression/DMA stream via 0x00D9A4 into VRAM destination.

0x0B.name: VM_OP_SET_MAX_ENEMIES
0x0B.semantics: Updates active enemy concurrency threshold in $FF17B7.

0x0C.name: VM_OP_LOAD_PALETTE_STAGE
0x0C.semantics: Copies 32 bytes from 0x05D046 to palette staging buffer $FF136C without immediate reload flag.

0x0D.name: VM_OP_LOAD_PALETTE_APPLY
0x0D.semantics: Copies 32 bytes from 0x05D046 to $FF136C and flags VDP reload (bset.b #0, $FF164D).

0x0E.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_COMPLEX_ENEMY
0x0E.semantics: Checks enemy cap, allocates entity slot, and initializes multi-piece enemy via 0x0102BE.

0x0F.name: VM_OP_SET_GLOBAL_FLAG
0x0F.semantics: Sets (1), clears (0), or toggles (2) bitflag in global table $FF0DBC (bit=idx&7, byte=idx>>3).

0x10.name: VM_OP_SET_AREA_FLAG
0x10.semantics: Sets (1), clears (0), or toggles (2) bitflag in area table $FF0E1C.

0x11.name: VM_OP_SET_ROOM_FLAG
0x11.semantics: Sets (1), clears (0), or toggles (2) bitflag in room table $FF0E2C.

0x12.name: VM_OP_TILEMAP_SPECIAL_ACTION
0x12.semantics: Sub-dispatcher via 0x00FAC2 (12 sub-actions: animated tiles, plane priority, water current, tile swapping).

0x13.name: VM_OP_CALL_SUBROUTINE
0x13.semantics: Saves current PC into $FF1836 and jumps to target bytecode subroutine address.

0x14.name: VM_OP_RETURN_SUBROUTINE
0x14.semantics: Restores script PC from $FF1836 (return from bytecode subroutine).

0x15.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_GATED_PROP
0x15.semantics: Tests bitflag (0=none, 1=$FF0DBC, 2=$FF0E1C, 3=$FF0E2C). If clear, spawns entity via 0x00DA2A + 0x00DF54. If set, skips 18-byte record.

0x16.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_STATIC_PROP
0x16.semantics: Unconditionally spawns entity using standard 18-byte record via 0x00DA2A + 0x008D06 + 0x00DF54.

0x17.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_ENEMY_WAVE
0x17.semantics: Spawns paired wave entities (#$72 and #$70) and synchronizes wave scheduler via 0x010300.

0x18.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_ITEM_CHEST
0x18.semantics: Allocates slot via 0x00D9F0; spawns chest or pickup object with payload ID and open callback 0x009AD6.

0x19.name: VM_OP_SPAWN_TRIGGER_OBJECT
0x19.semantics: Spawns interactive trigger entity (door, floor switch, chest) with default trigger callback 0x017A96.

0x1A.name: VM_OP_PLAY_SOUND_EFFECT
0x1A.semantics: Sends sound effect command packet to Z80 audio driver via 0x00E78E.

0x1B.name: VM_OP_PLAY_BGM_TRACK
0x1B.semantics: Sends BGM playback command to sound driver via 0x060004.

0x1D.name: VM_OP_PLANE_SCROLL_EFFECT
0x1D.semantics: Configures auto-scroll delta on Plane A ($FF1716) or Plane B ($FF173E) via 0x00DB64.

0x1E.name: VM_OP_CAMERA_CUTSCENE_LOCK
0x1E.semantics: Locks camera on target coordinates, activates cutscene flag $FF1982=0xFF, sets camera mode $FF19EC=2, and yields execution.
